description: This file is a shell script for testing Git rebase autosquash and fixup functionalities. It contains setup procedures, multiple test cases, and utility functions to automate and verify Git rebasing behaviors involving fixup and squash commits.

methods.name: test_auto_fixup
methods.description: Tests the auto fixup behavior with various arguments and checks the resulting commit log and file contents.

methods.name: test_auto_squash
methods.description: Tests the auto squash behavior, verifying commit logs and diffs after rebase with autosquash enabled.

methods.name: test_auto_commit_flags
methods.description: Tests the usage of commit flags like --fixup and --squash, verifying the resulting commit messages and structure.

methods.name: test_auto_fixup_fixup
methods.description: Tests automatic fixup and squash commits with different message prefixes and their behavior after rebasing.
